prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Quality Safety Stage: Adds a pre-generation inspection screen allowing users to verify lighting and pet outline before rendering custom AI models.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_validator", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"headline": "Verify Your Pet Photo Quality", "body": "Ensure clear lighting and a single visible pet before rendering.", "layout": "stage"}}
1: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Summoning Sandbox: Introduces an interactive desktop summoning sandbox on the finish step where users practice calling, clicking, and dismissing their pet directly on screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Master Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Try calling your pet and using system tray shortcuts before concluding setup.", "layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "text": "Click me to practice desktop pet actions!", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "checklist", "text": "Practice summon, hide, and call commands", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Display Diagnostic Stage: Inserts a display diagnostic check during render waiting to test desktop overlay permissions and multi-monitor placement.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_display_diagnostics", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"headline": "Testing Desktop Display Compatibility", "body": "Verifying overlay permissions while your companion renders.", "layout": "checklist"}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Onboarding Path Redesign: Redesigns the path selection into an interactive mascot-guided choice stage comparing preset adoption speed versus custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Adoption Journey", "body": "Choose Instant Companion for speed or Custom Studio for total personalization.", "layout": "split", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Instant vs Custom Path", "style": "highlight"}]}}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Safeguard Modal: Shows a clear prompt explaining how sign-in protects pet data across device re-installs and logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet's Unique Memories", "body": "Sign in to bind your pet's custom traits and progress safely to your cloud account.", "hint": "Prevents lost pets or account resets when switching devices.", "layout": "centered"}}
5: [adoption, layout] Instant Companion Audio & Visual Preview Grid: Overhauls the pick_friend layout into a split interactive showcase featuring instant pet audio clips and animation previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Meet Your Potential Companions", "body": "Preview behaviors and voice clips before finalizing your adoption.", "layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "sound", "text": "Listen to sound samples", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_grid", "style": "rounded"}]}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Interactive Companion Teaser: Updates the story screen copy and button labels to clearly outline what desktop pets do before choosing a path.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Your Virtual Desktop Companion Awaits", "body": "Adopt an animated pet that lives on your screen, reacts to your work, and keeps you company.", "button_label": "Start Adoption Journey"}}
7: [home, redesign] Render Waiting Screen Interactive Care Mini-Game: Redesigns the waiting screen into an interactive care mini-game where users feed virtual treats while background assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Your Pet is Arriving!", "body": "Play with temporary desktop treats while background setup completes.", "layout": "stage", "replace": {"wait_status": [{"role": "wait_status", "type": "mascot", "text": "Feed pet treats while loading", "style": "playful"}]}}}
8: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Quick Reference Overlay: Displays a persistent shortcut cheat sheet on home_intro showing system tray icon locations and quick hotkeys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Desktop Control Cheat Sheet", "body": "Your companion sits in your system tray. Right-click anytime to access controls or hide.", "hint": "Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+P summons pet instantly to your cursor position.", "layout": "checklist"}}
9: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Creation Expectation Callout: Adds clear render time estimates and photo guidelines on the upload_photos screen before creation begins.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Custom Pet Photo Requirements", "body": "Upload 1 to 3 clear photos. Custom rendering takes approximately 60 seconds.", "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Clear single pet photos ensure the best 3D desktop model conversion."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of a photo validation screen within onboarding.
Valid home_intro sandbox enhancement for learning desktop pet controls.
The waiting screen loses its primary job of showing that the pet is being made, replacing it with a display diagnostic check.
Valid redesign of choose_path preserving both instant adoption and custom creation paths.
Valid sign_in prompt addition explaining account persistence.
Valid redesign of pick_friend screen offering audio and animation previews.
Valid story screen copy update introducing the pet concept.
Valid waiting screen redesign with a mini-game while showing the pet is arriving.
Valid home_intro cheat sheet overlay detailing desktop pet hotkeys.
Valid upload_photos update adding render timing expectations and photo requirements.
